purpose: Reuse the immutable accepted resolution-192 surface_distance=2.5 Data cache for exactly one Mesh-only reconstruction and test source-relative volume, temporal drift, signed topology and cup containment before slow tip.

authority.allowed: One fresh local-only Blender process, one copied immutable Data cache, one Mesh bake, one workspace save, static measurement and independent audit; zero Data bake, render, network or engine remote write.

sceneStateReconstruction.rule: Open an ordinary copy of the exact source blend, reconstruct the exact Data-bake scene transforms and physical settings before binding the copied cache, bind the copied absolute cache directory last, and require the exact 14-file Data roster plus has_cache_baked_data=true before Mesh authority.
sceneStateReconstruction.useFlipParticlesRule: Preserve the coherent source true/one FLIP roster without assigning the toggle-style RNA property.

meshConfiguration.selectionBasis: Retained resolution-192 matrix candidate with maximum source-volume error 0.04402087 and maximum temporal drift 0.0154918; this gate changes Data obstacle formation, not reconstruction settings.

stopRule: Stop on non-fresh roots, dirty research tree, retained evidence/work/Data drift, source or binary drift, scene-state reconstruction mismatch, missing baked-Data flag, any copied Data byte change, a cache roster other than 14 Data files before and 21 Data+Mesh files after, any Data bake, more than one Mesh bake/save/start, render/network/remote write, symlink, banned media or resource failure. Do not tune another surface variable, repeat Data, proceed to slow tip or hide a failed surface.
claimCeiling: One Mesh-only reconstruction from the accepted Final obstacle-level-set Data signal. A PASS proves the retained static seven-frame cache meets the frozen volume, drift, signed-topology and one-voxel cup-containment thresholds only; it does not prove slow tip, impact, lighting, camera or finished-film quality.
